title: Kyiv — City Above the River
subtitle: Seven scenes through water, gold, stone, streets, and a city that keeps becoming.

chapters.title: Before the Streets
chapters.text: Kyiv begins with geography: a wide river, steep green hills, islands, mist, and paths climbing from the water. Long before domes defined the skyline, the Dnipro gave the city its horizon and its direction.

chapters.title: A House That Dreams
chapters.text: Horodecki’s house turns the respectable city into a strange bestiary. Rhinoceroses, frogs, elephants, and sea creatures climb across concrete, proving that Kyiv’s architectural memory also has room for wit and dreams.

chapters.title: A City That Returns
chapters.text: Kyiv is not a finished monument. It is morning coffee after a difficult night, voices returning to the square, chestnuts flowering again, and the Dnipro still carrying light past the hills.
